description: Files the number on a beneficial owner's passport or US driver's license against a banking application, for an owner who has no SSN or ITIN. Record the document first (kind, issuing country, expiry, and the issuing state for a license) on the owner. The number goes to the secret store; only its last four are recorded, which is all the response returns. Pass it once and do not repeat it back. On an application already submitted it is refused with PERMISSION_DENIED: anything sent to the bank after submission is the applicant's to make. ABORTED means another change to this owner was in progress and nothing was written: call it again.
name: banking_set_owner_identity_document_number
title: Set Owner Identity Document Number
